decisions.reason: After four years the uncertainty around this adjacent conferencing offer is largely resolved, and in a crowded market with limited differentiation from the firm's core infrastructure strengths its remaining option value no longer justifies keeping it open.

This optical connectivity service still fits the firm's owned network assets and software-defined high-bandwidth strategy, so management would keep the option open because its strategic upside remains credible and the fit with core capabilities is strong.

The number-ordering portal is a low-cost digital extension of the existing voice business that supports automation and customer self-service, so it is worth retaining while it continues to improve efficiency and complement the wider service portfolio.

Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony product with weak alignment to the firm's future direction, and by 2022 enough is known to conclude that resources are better redeployed to established core services and new development.
